تختزلين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَزِلِينَ (taḵtazilīna) /tax.ta.zi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# تُخْتَزَلِينَ (tuḵtazalīna) /tux.ta.za.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
